description: Compare 2–5 platforms side by side on published fields only — payload, runtime, weight, speed, IP rating, temperature range, price, autonomy, coordination, control, perception, environments, sectors, evidence stage, access and lifecycle. Every cell says whether the value is published, unpublished or an editorial estimate, who stated it (manufacturer, press) and under what test conditions. There is no ranking or winner: present it as a table of facts and say which values are unknown. Use this when the user is choosing between named platforms.
